name: process beforeExit re-arm and exit event
source: function main(): void { let n: number = 0; process.on('beforeExit', (code: number): void => { console.log('beforeExit', code, n); if (n++ < 1) setTimeout((): void => console.log('more'), 1); }); process.on('exit', (code: number): void => console.log('exit', code)); console.log('main'); }
